reasons.action: The brief explicitly asks for a new temporal motion — the car pulls forward — which overrides the static showroom pose of the frame-anchor plate.
reasons.medium: The medium decision pins the live-action cinematic rendering; restyling was not requested, so the medium owner remains the reference.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing, accessory or finish change is requested; the subject's observed carbon fibre body is retained as the reference describes it.
reasons.lighting: 'Out of the dark' is narrative ambience/mood rather than an instruction about a light source, its direction or visible quality, so the showroom's observed lighting is kept; only the motion is specified.
reasons.framing: No camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or movement is requested — the 16:9 canvas and the car's travel are not framing instructions — so the reference composition governs.
reasons.palette: 'Out of the dark' is a situational state rather than a requested scene colour palette, and the car's black incidental colour does not recolor the world, so reference palette is retained.
